pins.name: BUTTON
pins.label: GPIO12 (Button)
pins.notes: PIN_SWITCH / board.BUTTON — onboard BOOT/user pushbutton, diode-shared with the QSPI chip-select bootloader-select line (same pattern as ../pimoroni_tiny2040 GPIO23). Confirmed mechanical pushbutton (not capacitive touch) via Adafruit's own CircuitPython digital-input example (digitalio.DigitalInOut(board.BUTTON), pull-up) and docs.zephyrproject.org's Trinkey QT2040 board page. digital_output/pwm_output deliberately omitted — no vendor source confirms driving this diode-coupled line as an output is safe.

pins.name: NEOPIXEL
pins.label: GPIO27 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes: PIN_NEOPIXEL — onboard WS2812 addressable RGB LED, output-only. Confirmed via Adafruit's own CircuitPython example (neopixel.NeoPixel(board.NEOPIXEL, 1)) and learn.adafruit.com/adafruit-trinkey-qt2040 ('Built-in RGB NeoPixel LED').
